planets.name: TOI-1811 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1811 with a 3.71-day year, found in 2023.

text.card: TOI-1811 b was found in 2023 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1811. Its orbit and size follow Rodriguez et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
